# Summary Resolve

Component ID: summary-resolve

## Purpose and selection

- Close an explained topic with 2–4 grounded takeaways and one clear decision.

Do not use:

- Do not introduce new evidence at the end or force an upbeat conclusion unsupported by the source.

## Supported inputs

- title: Supply real title within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
- items: Supply 2–4 entries separated by "|", each with exactly 2 nonempty fields separated by "::". Keep each field within 64 characters.
- highlight: Use a real in-range integer; a focus index must point to an existing item.
- note: Supply real supporting note within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.

## Reading order and motion

- Recall the evidence
- Read the takeaways
- Hold the resulting decision

Pattern: focus-transfer. Native default duration: 8s. Minimum final readable hold: 0.7s.

### step-1

- Target: .vc-item:nth-child(1)
- Visible action: Recall the established need
- Authored start: 1.2s; action duration: 0.5s.
- Narration cue: When narration reaches items 1, recall the established need. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.

### step-2

- Target: .vc-item:nth-child(2)
- Visible action: Recall the enabling condition
- Authored start: 2.6s; action duration: 0.5s.
- Narration cue: When narration reaches items 2, recall the enabling condition. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.

### step-3

- Target: .vc-item:nth-child(3)
- Visible action: Keep the uncertainty visible
- Authored start: 4.1s; action duration: 0.5s.
- Narration cue: When narration reaches items 3, keep the uncertainty visible. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.

### step-4

- Target: .vc-item:nth-child(4)
- Visible action: Reveal the next decision
- Authored start: 5.5s; action duration: 0.5s.
- Narration cue: When narration reaches items 4, reveal the next decision. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.

### resolve

- Target: .vc-item
- Visible action: Restore the full readable relationship
- Authored start: 6.6s; action duration: 0.55s.
- Narration cue: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

## Known failure modes and recovery

- overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or use a more suitable component; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
- missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults or custom graphics under recipes-only policy.
- timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
- inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.
